title: Whole-cell proteomics and Analysis by Tandem Mass Tagging-based proteomics
author: Felix Kraus
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bxa4pigw
materials: Replace tube with 2 ml collection tube.

steps.title: Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Lyse cells using lysis buffer, either by passing them through a 21G needle 10 times or by sonication according to manufacturer's instructions. 50 µg of protein lysate is required per replicate.

steps.title: Clarification of Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the suspensions at 13,000 rpm at 4 °C for 10 minutes and collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Reduction and Alkylation
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 µg of quantified protein lysate for each sample into clean 1.5 mL protein Lo-Bind Eppendorf tubes. Reduce lysates for 20 minutes at room temperature with 5 mM TCEP, then alkylate cysteine residues with 20 mM Chloroacetamide for 30 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Protein Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract protein content using methanol-chloroform precipitation and subsequent MeOH washes.

substeps.instruction: Add 4x volumes of MeOH and vortex.
Resuspend protein pellets in 100 µL of 200 mM EPPS buffer (pH 8.5).

steps.title: Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Perform sequential digestion of the samples at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Digest for 2 hours with endoproteinase Lys-C (Wako, Japan) at a 1/200 enzyme/protein ratio.
Digest with Trypsin (1:100) for 6 hours.

steps.title: TMT Labeling
steps.instruction: Label the protein lysate with TMT reagents in a final concentration of 20-25% ACN.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL of TMT reagent (solubilized in ACN) for every 50 µg of protein lysate.
Add 20 µL of ACN to bring the total reaction volume to 125 µL.
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: TMT Labeling Cleanup
steps.instruction: Clean up the labeled samples using a chloroform/methanol wash procedure.

substeps.instruction: Add 1x volume of chloroform and vortex.
Add 3x volume of water and vortex.
Spin down at room temperature for 5 minutes at high speed.
Aspirate and discard the upper aqueous phase, ensuring the protein disc at the interface is not disturbed.
Add 4x volumes of MeOH and vortex.
Spin down at room temperature for 5 minutes at high speed.
Air dry or speed-vac the protein pellet to remove all traces of MeOH.
Repeat the MeOH wash and aspirate the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Labeling Efficiency Ratio Check
steps.instruction: Perform a ratio check to test labeling efficiency using a combined aliquot of samples.

substeps.instruction: Combine 1% of each labeled sample in a tube.
Quench the reaction with 4 µL of 5% hydroxylamine for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Dry down using a speed-vac.
Resuspend the dried sample in 100 µL of 5% FA/5% ACN.
Verify the pH is ~3 or lower using pH strips.
Prepare a stage tip by placing 6-8 C-18 embedded membrane 'cookies' in a 200 µL Rainin tip.
Equilibrate C-18 with 100 µL of 100% methanol.
Wash C-18 with 50 µL of 50% ACN/5% FA, then with 100 µL of 5% ACN/5% FA.
Load the sample onto the C-18 to bind peptides.
Wash bound peptides with 50 µL of 5% ACN/5% FA.
Elute peptides with 50 µL of 75% ACN/5% FA into a mass spec vial.
Dry down eluted peptides in a speed-vac.
Reconstitute peptides in 10 µL of 5% ACN/5% FA.
Analyze the total amount of reporter ions via mass spectrometry for each TMT channel.

steps.title: Sample Quenching and Normalization
steps.instruction: Quench the remaining labeled samples and combine them based on the ratio check normalization values.

substeps.instruction: Quench the entire volume of each sample using 8 µL of 5% hydroxylamine for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Combine samples in a 2 mL Eppendorf tube to equal amounts based on normalization values.
Dry down the combined sample in a speed-vac.

steps.title: SepPak Cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify the combined sample using a SepPak column on a vacuum manifold.

substeps.instruction: Reconstitute the sample in 750 µL of 5% ACN/5% FA.
Place SepPak column in vacuum slot; start vacuum gently (pressure gauge below 10) so fluid passes drop-wise.
Fill SepPak with 1 mL of 5% FA/50% ACN and flow through.
Fill SepPak with 1 mL of 5% FA/5% ACN and flow through; repeat 2 more times.
Load peptides (~750 µL) and flow through.
Wash 2 times with 1 mL of 5% FA/5% ACN.
Replace the 15 mL collection tube with a 2 mL collection tube.
Elute with 750 µL of 75% ACN/5% FA, ensuring all liquid flows through.
Dry down in SpeedVac at room temperature overnight or at 30 °C.
Fill SepPak with 1 mL of 100% MeOH.

steps.title: High-pH Reverse-Phase HPLC Fractionation
steps.instruction: Fractionate the sample using an Agilent LC1260 high-pH reverse-phase HPLC.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend sample in 100 µL of 10 mM NH4HCO3 pH 8.
Fractionate into 96 fractions over a 1.5 hour run using an Aeris peptide XB-c18 column (Phenomenex; 250 mm x 3.6 mm).
Use Mobile Phase A (5% ACN, 10 mM NH4HCO3 pH 8) and Mobile Phase B (90% ACN, 10 mM NH4HCO3 pH 8), both in LC-MS grade H2O.

steps.title: Fraction Processing and Final Cleanup
steps.instruction: Combine fractions and perform a final C-18 cleanup before storage.

substeps.instruction: Combine fractionated samples (either 12 or 24 fractions) in a non-continuous manner into individual 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.
Dry down in SpeedVac.
Resuspend peptides in 100 µL of 5% FA/5% ACN and check pH (~3.5) with indicator strips.
Prepare and equilibrate stage tips; spin down at 3000 rpm for 3 minutes.
Wash C-18 with 50 µL of 50% ACN/5% FA and 100 µL of 5% ACN/5% FA.
Load sample and collect flow-through for freezing.
Wash with 50 µL of 50% ACN/5% FA.
Elute with 50 µL of 75% ACN/1% FA into a mass spec vial.
Dry down in SpeedVac.
Reconstitute pellet in 10 µL of 5% FA/5% ACN.
Freeze sample at -20 °C until proteomics analysis.
